te: Industry's need for sea freight, and the Smart Port
se: Meeting on Thursday 26 November 2026 at 09.30 hrs, Committee Meeting Room CA 427, floor 4, Parliament House. The agenda is to consider industry's potential and need for sea freight, especially the volume, type and origin of goods that could use ports on the Andaman Sea coast, and what industry needs from a Smart Port using digital technology, automation and data links to raise efficiency and cut logistics costs. Representatives of the Department of Industrial Promotion and related private trade and freight bodies are invited, as set out in the meeting notice. A summary will be added after the Senate publishes the meeting summary.
it: Industry's potential and need for sea freight, and what it needs from a Smart Port

te: Following the ratification of ILO Conventions No. 87 and No. 98: hearing the private sector and employers
se: Meeting on Wednesday 25 November 2026 at 10.00 hrs, Committee Meeting Room CA 320, floor 3, Parliament House. The agenda is to consider and follow the process of ratifying International Labour Organization (ILO) Conventions No. 87 and No. 98 and related issues, with representatives of the private sector and employers' organisations invited, as set out in the meeting notice. A summary will be added after the Senate publishes the meeting summary.
it: Considering and following the ratification of ILO Conventions No. 87 and No. 98 and related issues (hearing the private sector and employers)
